MOC.title: About Department
about: PG Department of Commerce at NCMS was started in the year 2018. It is a two-year postgraduate program that focuses on various aspects of commerce, economics, accounting, finance, banking, investment, insurance and other related fields. This program provides in-depth knowledge and understanding of concepts and practices in the commerce and business arena. It is offered to the students who are interested to pursue their mastery in the field of commerce and reach a state of excellence in their domain. The course exposes aspiring students to bag different positions and have a promising career in multinational companies with a high paying job in the fields of Banking, Accounting, Auditing, Finance, Human Resource Management and Taxation to name a few. This course also gives a big leap for those who likes to pursue teaching profession in both, government and private colleges and also for those interested in taking up CA, CS & CMA as their profession.

UG_Commerce.title: About Department
about: The Department of Commerce and Management started in the year 2015, provides graduate programs: B.Com and BBA, affiliated to Bengaluru North University, Tamaka, Kolar. These programs provide students with a strong foundation in Accounting and Management. It offers electives such as Accounting and Taxation, Finance, Marketing, Human Resources to name few. The curriculum adheres to the guidelines set forth by the University.

The department has highly qualified and experienced teaching staff who are committed and contribute to the academic and holistic growth of the students. The course is application-focused; the department thus prepares students to experience Internship opportunities, Training and Placement sessions by Industry Experts, Leadership Development, Personality Development, Industrial Visits and overall Skill Enhancement through certification programmes, MOOC courses, Guest Lectures, Workshops, and Field Visits.

The Department of Commerce and Management has recorded consistent improvement in its academic and placement performance. It offers a range of innovatively designed programs whose curriculum are constantly updated to meet the changing requirement of the industry and to meet the needs of major stakeholders.

The Department also encourages students to organize events to enhance their skills and participate in management events organized by other colleges and also get involved in activities of social relevance.

Department’s goal is to impart value-based education along with the development of positive attitude, excellent communication skills and developing the abilities through Training programs, Club Activities, Cultural & Sports Activities etc.

DOK.title: About Department
about: ನಾಗಾರ್ಜುನ ಕಾಲೇಜ್ ಆಫ್ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಸ್ಟಡೀಸ್, ಚಿಕ್ಕಬಳ್ಳಾಪುರ, ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಕನ್ನಡ ವಿಭಾಗವು ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ವಿಭಾಗದ ಶ್ರೀ ಅಂಬರೀಶ್ ಎ., ಶ್ರೀಮತಿ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿದೇವಿ ಎನ್., ಶ್ರೀಮತಿ ಶೋಭಾ ಬಿ.ವಿ., ಶ್ರೀ. ಸುರೇಶ್ ಎನ್., ಶ್ರೀ ಸಿದ್ಧರಾಮು ಅವರುಗಳು ಸಮರ್ಥವಾಗಿ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಬರುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಗಡಿನಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಕೊಂಡಿರುವ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಇಂದಿನ ಆಧುನಿಕತೆಯ ಅಬ್ಬರದ ನಡುವೆ ಯಾಂತ್ರಿಕವಾಗುತ್ತಿರುವ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಆಯಾಮಗಳ ಪರಿಚಯವನ್ನು ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಿಕ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಗಳು, ಉಪನ್ಯಾಸ, ಕಮ್ಮಟ, ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಗಳು, ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ, ಅಂತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿಚಾರ ಸಂಕಿರಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಂದ ಪ್ರಬಂಧ ಮಂಡನೆ, ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಂದಲೇ ರಚಿತವಾದ ಕನ್ನಡ ಕವನ ಸಂಕಲನ ಪುಸ್ತಕ “ಪಾತರಗಿತ್ತಿ”,”ಸವಿ ಕನ್ನಡ–ನಲಿ ಕನ್ನಡ” ಮುಂತಾದ ವಿನೂತನ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಹಮ್ಮಿಕೊಂಡು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಿತ್ಯಾಸಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇವೆ.ಕನ್ನಡ ಭಾಷೆಯ ಬಗೆಗೆ ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಒಲವು, ಆಸಕ್ತಿನ್ನು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಸುವ ನಿಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವಾರು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಗಳು ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದೆ.ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾನವೀಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಮೂಡಿಸಲು ಬಯಲು ಬಂಧೀಖಾನೆ ಭೇಟಿ, ವೃದ್ಧಾಶ್ರಮ, ಅನಾಥಶ್ರಮ ಭೇಟಿ, ಪ್ರಕೃತಿಯೆಡೆಗೆ ಎನ್ನುವ ವಿನೂತನ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮದ ಮೂಲಕ ಪರಿಸರ ಕಾಳಜಿಯನ್ನು ಮೂಢಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸಾಗಿದೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಕನ್ನಡ ವಿಭಾಗವು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯದ ಅಭಿರುಚಿಯ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸಮಾಜದ ಸುಸಂಸ್ಕೃತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಗುರಿ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಅಷ್ಟೇ ಅಲ್ಲದೆ ಕನ್ನಡ ವಿಭಾಗದ ವತಿಯಿಂದ ರಾಷ್ಷ್ರೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ವಿಚಾರ ಸಂಕಿರಣ, ಅಧ್ಯಾಪಕ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮ(FDP) ಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಕನ್ನಡ ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯಿಕ ಚಟುವಟಿಕಗಳು ಸಕ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿವೆ.

UG_CA.title: About Department
about: The Department of Computer Applications (BCA) was started in the year 2018 and is continuously striving to produce skilled professionals in the field of computer applications. The department is delivering a top-notch education that equips students with the latest technical knowledge and skills to handle the ever-changing dynamics of the industry. Our accomplished and enthusiastic faculty use student centric teaching methods to ensure that students are well-prepared to navigate the dynamic tech landscape. At the department, emphasize is not only on academic excellence but also practical application, ensuring our graduates are ready to take on roles as problem solvers, project leaders, and entrepreneurs. To enhance employability students are offered with internships, industrial visits, and other opportunities to gain real-world experience. This collaboration with the tech industry provides our students with a strong foundation for their future careers.

Our commitment to a well-rounded education extends to extracurricular activities and leadership development. Through these activities, students develop teamwork, leadership skills, and a sense of community. Faculty members at the department encourage students to participate in international programs and conferences, providing a broader perspective on the global tech landscape. Department is dedicated to preparing the next generation of computer application professionals, who will excel in the ever-evolving tech industry.

Science.title: About Department
about: The Department of B.Sc in Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science offers a comprehensive interdisciplinary program, providing students with a profound understanding of fundamental principles in physics, mathematics, and computer science by encouraging a holistic approach to problem-solving, analytical thinking and practical skill development. In the department, students are engaged in interdisciplinary projects which often involve the application of mathematical modeling, computational simulations, and physics experiments, allowing students to explore the practical implications of their theoretical knowledge. To support practical learning, the department provides state-of-the-art laboratories, computing facilities, and access to relevant software tools. These resources enable students to conduct experiments, simulations, and collaborative projects that bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application.

MBA.title: About Department
about: The Department of MBA serves as a gateway to the high-profile world of management. Distinguished as a centre for MBA education, Department of MBA started in the year 2021 is offering comprehensive two year full time industry ready program affiliated to Bengaluru North University, Tamaka, Kolar duly approved by the AICTE.

The department has been striving to achieve excellence in imparting Management Education. The Institution emphasises the need for “Techno Managers” who embrace technology and analytics while excelling in their domain areas. The dynamic curriculum complemented by the University curriculum and rigorous academic practice, integrates industry expectations into the teaching-learning process. A holistic developmental approach, encompassing cultural, scientific, pedagogical strategies guide students to realise their potential.

The Department’s remarkable strengths is its erudite and accomplished faculty members with an average of over 20 years of experience who spearhead the process of transforming students into techno managers. This wealth of knowledge and expertise contributes to a robust learning environment for the students and provides an environment for thought and conversation, encouraging students to discover a wide range of possibilities.

Upholding its legacy of consistent success, the Department remains committed to sustaining its streak of excellence for years to come. The department firmly believes that learning goes beyond the classroom and organises regular student-industry interaction through guest sessions and corporate events. Vibrant student committees and clubs enhance the programme, offering a platform for the students to nurture their leadership skills.

MCA.title: About Department
about: The Department of Computer Applications (MCA) started in the year 2022, is a dynamic and innovative hub committed to shaping the future tech leaders through cutting-edge education and research. Our teaching methodologies are at the forefront of innovation, reflecting the reality that computer applications are the backbone of nearly every industry. Our experienced and dedicated faculty emphasize on modern techniques, hands-on projects, real-world case studies, and the latest educational technology equipping students with technical skills and adaptability. The department also focuses on research and innovation through, exploration, questioning, and problem-solving. With faculty-guided research projects and access to state-of-the-art resources, students contribute to academic knowledge and impact society. Beyond technical skills, we emphasize holistic development. We offer opportunities for extracurricular engagement, leadership, and community service. Graduates emerge with the soft skills and ethical foundation needed to thrive in their careers and make a positive impact.

We bridge academia with industry, maintaining strong ties with tech companies for internship and collaborative projects. These real-world experiences make our students highly employable. A global perspective is vital in our interconnected world. We encourage participation in international programs and conferences, exposing students to diverse cultures and ideas. Our student-centric approach ensures their aspirations, concerns, and ideas are central to our department’s continuous improvement. We are dedicated to nurturing the next generation of tech leaders in the world of computer applications.

DOH.title: About Department
about: चिक्कमरलि,चिक्कबल्लापुर में स्थित नागार्जुन कॉलेज ऑफ मैनेजमेंट स्टडीज की स्थापना सन् 2015 में हुई। इस महाविद्यालय का हिन्दी विभाग अहिंदी प्रदेश के छात्र छात्राओं को हिन्दी भाषा और साहित्यिक शिक्षा के साथ प्रयोजनमूलक हिंदी के रूप से परिचय कराता है lराष्ट्रीय एकता, सामाजिक न्याय, धर्म निरपेक्षता, सांप्रदायिक सद्भाव और सामाजिक समस्याओं के प्रति वैज्ञानिक दॄष्‍टिकोण से समग्र अध्ययन के लिए पाठ्यक्रम का निर्माण करता है। इसीलिए जन संचार और मल्टी मीडिया के बढ़ते वर्चस्व को ध्यान रखते हुए हिन्दी के व्यवहारिक पक्षसंबंधी अनेक डिग्री पाठ्यक्रम उपलब्ध कराता है।

DOE.title: About Department
about: “THE LIMITS OF MY LANGUAGE MEAN THE LIMITS OF MY WORLD.” – LUDWIG WITTGENSTEIN.

Proficiency in language is vital for expressing thoughts and emotions with precision and impact. Gaining proficiency in language enriches one’s profile and enhances overall personality. The Department of English is dedicated to unlocking opportunities and enriching experiences by fostering effective communication, thereby elevating the learning journey for students. The foundation of language learning rests upon four essential pillars: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Integrating these pillars into the curriculum ensures a well-rounded development of linguistic abilities. Additionally, our goal is to cultivate intellectual curiosity, analytical and interpretive thinking, and broaden students’ horizons as they engage in the learning process.
